summary: Frontend-only test completed for global theme behavior. On local Expo web preview (http://127.0.0.1:3000), Settings theme switch works, app does not crash, and Air Management follows the same global theme (dark/light) after toggle. Public tunnel preview URL was unstable/unavailable (502 / preview not responding), so public-endpoint UI verification could not be completed reliably.

ui_bugs.issue: Interactive elements are missing testID/data-testid attributes, which reduces automation reliability for regression testing.

integration_issues.issue: Public preview URL (https://github-ffh-1.preview.emergentagent.com) returned 502/preview-not-responding during test run; blocked stable public-endpoint verification.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native WebView does not support this platform in Expo web preview; map area shows fallback text in browser tests.

action_items: Stabilize Expo tunnel/public preview route so frontend can be validated on the same endpoint as end users.
Add testID props to key interactive components for robust mobile-first E2E coverage.
Run device/emulator validation for strefa-zagrozenia WebView map behavior (web preview cannot validate native WebView rendering).
critical_code_review_comments: ThemeContext correctly derives default theme from useColorScheme and uses it when no override is stored (themeOverride === null).
Settings screen uses global theme context and toggleTheme without crash in test flow.
Air Management screen now consumes useTheme and updates palette with global dark/light changes (verified by UI and background samples).
Other referenced useTheme screen (strefa-zagrozenia) renders correctly with theme-based colors in tested web flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use local Expo web preview (http://127.0.0.1:3000) if tunnel is unstable. Verified: toggling theme in /ustawienia changes /zarzadzanie-powietrzem dark/light globally. Public preview instability is environmental and should be rechecked before final validation.
rca_of_issue: RCA (environment): Expo tunnel repeatedly failed in supervisor expo logs with ngrok errors (timeout/type error/failed to start tunnel), causing public preview 502 and 'preview environment is not responding'. Repro: open public preview URL and route paths; observe blank preview message and failed resource loads. Mitigation: stabilize tunnel startup and rerun public-endpoint UI pass.
test_credentials: Not required for this frontend-only scope (no auth flow tested).
